summary: Select Water Solutions, LLC, an indirect unit of Select Water Solutions, Inc. (NYSE: WTTR), agreed on September 24, 2026 to acquire all membership interests of Pilot Water Solutions LLC from Pilot OFS Holdings LLC and Minerva Infrastructure IA LLC under a Membership Interest Purchase Agreement. Consideration totals $600M cash plus $100M in WTTR Class A shares priced at the 30-day VWAP before closing, and a $15M contingent operational milestone payment, implying roughly $715M headline value subject to adjustments and a six-month share-price true-up. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or close date was disclosed; customary reps, covenants, and adjustments apply. Watch regulatory clearances, financing, share overhang, and the true-up reset.
